links.outcome: LLM triage accuracy against nurse-assigned KTAS on real-world conversations across models
links.effect: Among 1,057 real triage cases, Gemini 2.5 flash reached 73.8% accuracy and Gemini 2.5 pro 90.9% sensitivity; performance varied widely across models and versions.
links.quote: Performance varied widely between models and even between different versions from the same vendor.

links.outcome: Comparison of multiple LLMs against each other and nurse KTAS gold standard on same data
links.effect: Eight LLMs compared on identical cases; accuracy, sensitivity and specificity differed widely (e.g., Gemini 2.5 pro sensitivity 90.9% but specificity 23.3%; GPT-4.1 accuracy 70.6%).
links.quote: Gemini 2.5 pro demonstrated the highest sensitivity (90.9%) and F1-score (82.4%), though with lower specificity (23.3%).

unlisted_practices: few-shot prompting with representative examples to improve LLM triage accuracy

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of multiple LLMs' triage accuracy against gold standard KTAS using recorded patient-nurse triage dialogues (prompting conditions compared, but no deployment practice/safeguard tested).
